title: host.updates_hold (platform → host)
description: Sets csm's update hold (csm updates hold on|off|auto); the auto-update monitor reads it. Reliable; answered by exactly one host.result (ref = this message's id). Rejected with `expired` when expires_at is past, and with `stale` when the envelope ts is more than 5 min off the host's clock (a command replayed long after it was sent is not run).
